meta.title: Siaya County economy: Gross County Product (KNBS GCP 2025 and GCP 2024 editions)
meta.rule: Gross County Product measures the value added by all producers located in the county (output of the county economy). It is not county government revenue, budget or spending and must never be presented as such. Each edition is a separate vintage: values are never overwritten by a later edition, and revisions are recorded as differences. Values are printed values; gaps are listed, never filled.

definitions.gcp_total: Gross County Product, KSh million, as printed in the main GCP table
definitions.gcp_annex_total: GCP column printed in the activity annex (can differ from the main table by rounding)
definitions.gva_by_activity: Gross value added by economic activity (KNBS grouping of ISIC sections), current prices; FISIM is a negative adjustment, so the 18 activities plus FISIM sum to GCP
definitions.share_of_county_gva_total: Siaya’s percentage of the sum of all 47 counties’ GVA, as printed
definitions.real_growth_avg: Average annual growth of GCP at constant 2016 prices over the period, as printed in a chart
definitions.price_basis: current = current prices; constant_2016 = constant 2016 prices
definitions.provisional: true where the edition marks the year with * (Provisional). Every GCP 2025 table title carries + (Revised).
definitions.confidence: 5 = clean text-layer table cell; 4 = text-layer chart label matched by position; 3 = OCR of a chart label
definitions.revision: difference = GCP2025 value minus GCP2024 value; difference_pct is relative to GCP2024

gaps.reason: Not published as a county value. Both editions publish each county’s share of the sum of county GVA (Table 9 in GCP 2025, Table 6 in GCP 2024); GCP excludes taxes on products, so this is not a share of GDP at market prices. KNBS’s own GCP 2024 Figure 2 caption calls it “share of Gross Domestic Product”. Recorded here under its table name.
GCP 2025 annexes give activity values for 2022, 2023 and 2024 only.
GCP 2024 annexes give activity values for 2021, 2022 and 2023 only.
No activity breakdown at constant prices is published in either edition.
Neither edition prints a year-by-year real growth rate for Siaya; only the period average in a chart. Annual rates are not derived here.
